notes:
Account background: Larkspur runs contact center and payment reconciliation for ~120 hospital billing call centers. Heavy PCI and PHI surface — tokenized card storage + patient identifiers in tickets. Core stack: Genesys cloud + custom case management. Current AI: small in-house NLU used for intent triage; ops want to move to production-grade agent assist + ticket summarization with deterministic audit trails.

Recent timeline / activity: 
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Jordan) — high level needs, legal flagged PCI scope right away.
- 2026-01-29: Architecture workshop (Maya, infra) — went over VPC options, KMS requirements.
- 2026-02-18: Use-case deep-dive (ff-20260218-43) — agent assist demo request; asked about tool-calling (CRM writes, payment tokenization flow).
- 2026-03-02: Security gating call (ff-20260302-17) with Security + Legal — asked for SOC2 + PCI artifacts, data residency statement.
- 2026-03-08: Pre-POC sync — agreed scope for 2-week POC focused on: fast agent suggestions, 3-line ticket summarization, and a safe tool-calling shim for masked charge reversals.

Use-case & requirements (bullets):
- Primary: Real-time agent-assist (chat/omnicanal) integrated into Genesys; suggestions should appear <250ms median for top-1 suggestion under normal load.
- Secondary: Automated ticket summarization and structured extraction for billing codes (batched nightly).
- Tool-calling: must support verified CRM writebacks via signed function calls, with replayable audit records and per-call auth.
- Throughput/scale: 4k concurrent agents across regions; peak spikes 3x baseline during billing cycles/insurance season.
- SLOs: 99.9% availability, median latency target 150-250ms for agent assist, 95th pct <450ms.
- Models: prefer open-/fine-tuned models that can run in private VPC; quantized variants acceptable. Must support deterministic rollout and model pinning.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay for predictability (dedicated) but needs tooling to keep per-token cost bounded.

Security/compliance specifics:
- PCI: No PAN in clear; any partial tokens must be masked and only stored in HSM-backed KMS. Need PCI scoping guidance for caching layers.
- PHI/hipaa: retention policy strict — default retention 7 years; Legal wants retention_controls and deletion audit to demonstrate compliance.
- SSO: Enterprise SAML (Okta) + SCIM provisioning required.
- Audit: Full request/response logging for >1 year, immutable audit logs, exportable for e-discovery.
- Encryption: Customer-manage keys (HSM/KMS) and at-rest encryption for caches and KV.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: Provide VPC deployment checklist + SOC2/PCI artifacts; share small infra diagram and endpoint routing options.
- Week 1: Deploy private inference in customer VPC (staging), integrate with Genesys dev tenant, run synthetic traffic profiles.
- Week 2: Live agent pilot with 50 super-users; measure latency, suggestion quality, false positive rate on payment actions; run security penetration checklist.
- Success criteria: sub-250ms median suggestion latency during pilot, audit logs captured for 100% of function calls, no PCI-scoping gaps identified by their consultants.

Quotes / call notes (verbatim snippets):
- "We can't have a black box touching PANs — every write must be auditable and reversible." — Head of Security.
- "If you can show stable latency during our Oct-Nov cycle, we'll move to dedicated capacity." — VP Ops.

- Show VPC network diagram with NAT/egress options and how fallbacks work if a zone loses capacity.

- Demonstrate SAML/SCIM user provisioning flow and per-route auth.
- Performance benchmark on 16GB A100 equiv for our model family and sequence lengths (avg 128 tokens) under 4k concurrent agent mix.
